name: db-splice-equivalence-was-unrecorded
body: The `domain.constraint.db-splice-equivalence` law spans both the code tables and the authored/transient tables of the spliced `db.lbug`. Its proving sites are `src/splice/apply.rs` and `tests/splice_e2e.rs`, and the full-rebuild projection it defines covers the authored/transient rows alongside the code rows.
